thread:
zoe: Drafting the changelog + relnotes for the docs push on Friday. Two items need coordination: (1) JS/TS SDK snippet migration for streaming, (2) a short known-issue about embeddings endpoint returning inconsistent dims for very short inputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :wave:

liam: On the JS side I noticed examples still use `client.streamModel('x')` shorthand. The SDK changed to `client.stream('x')` and returns an async iterator now. We should add a migration example and a one-liner in the breaking-changes section.

maya: Can you paste the migration snippet you'll add? I want to keep the relnote blurb concise.

liam: Sure. Thinking of something like:

    // old
    client.streamModel('kestrel', onData)

    // new
    for await (const chunk of client.stream('kestrel')) {
      onData(chunk)
    }

maya: Perfect. I'll add it under "Developer notes > SDK changes" and link to the SDK PR #4977.

carla: About the embeddings issue we've seen vector length mismatch when input is < 3 tokens for the quantized model path. Ops has a mitigation (route short inputs to non-quant) but we need to warn in the relnotes and docs guide.

ops-bot: incident-tracker: new incident created INC-2026 (embeddings-dim-regression). Engineers are investigating latency and vector-length discrepancy.

zoe: OK added a short "Known issues" bullet: "Embeddings: In rare cases, very short inputs may produce vectors with unexpected dimensions on quantized model variants. Workaround: use the non-quantized embedding model or pad inputs to at least 3 tokens. We are rolling a fix in the next minor release." Kept it terse.

liam: Also add a link to the embeddings troubleshooting doc and the incident page.

maya: Done. I also updated the relnotes homepage blurb: "Developer note: small SDK surface changes (JS/TS streaming) and a short known issue for embeddings on quantized paths. See detailed migration snippets below." Kept it one line.

doc-bot: link-checker: 3 broken links found: /docs/guides/migrations.md#streaming-js, /docs/reference/embeddings.md (anchor moved), /docs/api/client-js.md (old path). See issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1329

carla: I'll handle the embeddings doc anchor and add a redirect for the api/client-js path.

zoe: For docs-preview, I'm toggling the relnote to "compact" on mobile so it fits the whatsnew feed. Can we avoid long code blocks in the top-level summary? Put them in a collapsible "Migration examples" section.

liam: Agreed. Also request: make the JS snippet use `for await` not `then` chains to show modern patterns.

maya: Updated. I also added a tiny FAQ entry: "Will this change affect existing streaming integrations?" Answer: "Not if you use official SDKs; older custom wrappers may need small updates."

ops-bot: deploy-bot: preview build queued for pr-4921 (sha: d3f9a2)  https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/4921

carla: Quick note on perms: the redirect needs a tiny firewall rule tweak for private docs in the VPC docs site. I'll open a small infra PR and link it in the docs PR.

zoe: Can someone add a one-sentence release note for the changelog: "JS/TS SDK: streaming API simplified to async iterator; see migration snippet." Keep it under 120 chars.

liam: Pushed that exact line into changelog draft.

maya: If I don't hear objections by EOD Thursday I'll merge. Can the SDK team cut a patch note in the JS repo so we can link to an authoritative change log?

liam: Yep we'll publish a short note in the SDK repo when we cut the release. I'll tag you.

doc-bot: automated: reviewers requested: @liam, @carla, @maya.

zoe: Thanks everyone. I'll post the final relnotes link here after merge. :rocket:
